Weekly notes

Our kitchen bakes every morning from five. This week we are trying a brown butter batch with sea salt and a rye flour shortbread. Orders placed before noon ship the same day; orders after noon ship the next morning. Thank you for reading and for supporting a small shop.

Pickup is at the side door on Elm Street. Bring your order number. We close early on Sundays.
